method: The decisions rest on mission-coverage-v1328v (and 1328o/r) on candidate 1214cq in Edge of the World under the product controller, both source roles: the source grabs chain1 with the ordinary interact (native arkPlayerStateClimb, alternate-mode state 29), climbs up and down, and in the climbtop case climbs to the top and lets go; the partner is checked from its own climb presentation (ascending, descending and phases) on the observer. The game has one climbing state, arkPlayerStateClimb on arkClimbable chains; its only ladders are step-ladder props that are not climbable (confirmed static: resource index of the player state declarations and of every ladder resource). The mission take ends with the lab checkpoint restore and the protected-file check.

items.scope: Climbing the Edge of the World chain in both roles: grab, hand-over-hand ascent and descent cycles advanced by the replicated height (about 85-110 climb samples, 9-10 phases per case), climbing to the top and letting go back into the default mode.

visual.verdict: Corvo grabs the chain at the street, pulls himself up hand over hand, then climbs back down and steps off.
Emily climbs the chain all the way up, hangs at the top and lets go.

items.scope: D2 has no climbable ladders: the only climbing state is arkPlayerStateClimb on arkClimbable (the chains), and the ladder resources are step-ladder props (confirmed static). Entry, ascent, descent and exit of that climb are presented in both roles (chain_rope_climb, the same takes).

visual.verdict: Emily enters the climb from the street, ascends to the top and exits by letting go.
